alex: saw an odd process 'runc-helper' inside prod-ml-01 at ~08:12 UTC. Not restarting. Need evidence collection + KMS/audit correlation. @nisha @leo :eyes:
sara: Don’t restart. If someone grants node access Ill pull quick artifacts. Suggested cmds:
```
kubectl -n prod exec -it pod/prod-ml-01 -- ps aux --forest | grep runc-helper
kubectl -n prod cp pod/prod-ml-01:/proc/$(pgrep -f runc-helper)/cmdline ./cmdline.dump
kubectl -n prod exec pod/prod-ml-01 -- cat /proc/$(pgrep -f runc-helper)/environ > environ.dump
kubectl -n prod exec pod/prod-ml-01 -- ls -la /proc/$(pgrep -f runc-helper)/cwd
# capture overlay metadata
ctr containers info <cid> || docker inspect <container-id>
```
jamie: +1 leave running. Snapshot node disk if available. Verify image digest and cosign attestations before any restart. Dont redeploy until registry checks done.
michael: For registry checks: `crane manifest ${REG}/repo@sha256:...` and `cosign verify --keyless ${REG}/repo@sha256:...`. Also pull signer/KMS logs for 22:00-23:30 UTC yesterday.
eng-sre-bot: Incident created: SEC-2026-1072. Node metrics + pod logs archived to s3://redwood-incidents/SEC-2026-1072/ (metrics.tar.gz, pod-prod-ml-01-logs.gz).
nisha: Oncall here. Ill correlate registry access, artifact signing, and KMS envelope events. Who pulled the image and which SA? @leo can you wildcard pull events for the digest? If secrets (project-keystore) were mounted, rotate them ASAP.
leo: Registry: pulls for sha256:4fae... by ml-inferencer@prod between 07:58-08:05 UTC from 3 nodes. Also a pull by flow-checker@ci at 03:02 UTC. No pushes in that window. Will dump token mint events in 10m.
claire: If we rebuild/resign: follow minimal rebuild flow: rebuild base -> run staging smoke -> cosign resign with KMS key -> canary rollout. Hold full prod until evening window (22:00 UTC) unless active exploitation found.
alex: Action items: (1) sara capture proc dumps + fs metadata (2) leo token audit and pull list (3) nisha correlate KMS/signing logs + key-rotation if needed (4) jamie/claire plan fast rebuild/resign and hold canary. Im onlead for postmortem and comms.
sara: Capturing now. Uploaded evidence to s3://redwood-incidents/SEC-2026-1072/evidence/ (cmdline.dump, environ.dump, container-metadata.json, proc-tree.txt).
michael: cosign verify fails for that digest: `verification failed: no matching signatures found`. Might be a mirror stripping signatures. Adding to triage.
nisha: Treat as tamper suspicion. Revoke registry read token for ml-inferencer@prod and switch pods to a static signed image or block the digest via admission. Opening RBAC change PR to limit who can request short-lived registry tokens.
leo: Revoked ml-inferencer@prod token. Created scoped token for canary host only. Flagged CI token for review.
jamie: Forensics note: check kernel audit logs for execve, runc invocation, and snapshot overlay2 for that container layer. Dont alter overlay files.
claire: Blocking 22:00 UTC deploy window and prepping rebuild playbook. Emergency rebuild earlier requires nisha+leo signoff.
alex: Keep updates here. Ill file incident ticket and draft initial timeline. Thanks :thumbsup:
